title: Release manifest
description: Catalog row release-manifest 1.0.0: release.json, the manifest of a static deployment archive, written into the static build by scripts/package_static.py:52 at packaging time (never committed): the commit and version it was built from, every file of the build with its size and SHA-256, and the coverage record each validator returned before packaging (scripts/check_artifacts.py, check_operations.py, check_semantic_transfer.py, check_semantic_routing.py). release.json itself is not in its file list.

commit.description: The git commit (`git rev-parse HEAD`) the archive was built from.

files.description: Every file of the build except release.json, sorted by path.

path.description: Path relative to the build root, '/' separated.

canonical_coverage.description: What scripts/check_artifacts.py validated in the canonical evidence.

operation_coverage.description: What scripts/check_operations.py validated in the recorded operations.

coverage.description: The matrix in words, for example '3 tasks x 4 fault conditions x 3 seeds'.

semantic_coverage.description: What scripts/check_semantic_transfer.py validated in the semantic-transfer evidence.

routing_coverage.description: What scripts/check_semantic_routing.py validated in the routing study.
